groups.defect: The AccessTokenContext constructor checks grantType twice instead of validating rawTokenId, allowing a null raw token ID.
groups.rationale: All four identify the same incorrect argument in the fourth null check. Replacing that argument with rawTokenId resolves every report.

groups.defect: The access-token-ID matcher extracts the grant shortcut at the wrong offset, reverses the equality check, and can throw on malformed prefixes because it does not check their length before taking a substring.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the same incorrect substring range; all except s_be2a870e also report the inverted comparison. The merged comment must preserve both defects and the malformed-prefix handling raised by s_511ab22a.
